section.title: org.osgi.service.upnp
section.para: UPnP Package Version 1.2.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.upnp; version="[1.2,2.0)"}
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.upnp; version="[1.2,1.3)"}

listitem.para: UPnPEventListener - UPnP Events are mapped and delivered to applications according to the OSGi whiteboard model.
UPnPException - There are several defined error situations describing UPnP problems while a control point invokes actions to UPnPDevices.
UPnPLocalStateVariable - A local UPnP state variable which allows the value of the state variable to be queried.
UPnPService - A representation of a UPnP Service.
UPnPStateVariable - The meta-information of a UPnP state variable as declared in the device's service state table (SST).

section.title: public abstract UPnPAction
section.para:
A UPnP action.
Each UPnP service contains zero or more actions. Each action may have zero or more UPnP state variables as arguments.

section.title: public abstract String[][] getInputArgumentNames()
section.para: Lists all input arguments for this action.
Each action may have zero or more input arguments.
This method must continue to return the action input argument names after the UPnP action has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: Array of input argument names or {@code null} if no input arguments.

section.title: public abstract String getName()
section.para:
Returns the action name.
The action name corresponds to the {@code name} field in the {@code actionList} of the service description.

listitem.para: For standard actions defined by a UPnP Forum working committee, action names must not begin with {@code X_ } nor {@code A_}.
For non-standard actions specified by a UPnP vendor and added to a standard service, action names must begin with {@code X_}.

section.para: This method must continue to return the action name after the UPnP action has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: Name of action, must not contain a hyphen character or a hash character

section.title: public abstract String[][] getOutputArgumentNames()
section.para: List all output arguments for this action.
This method must continue to return the action output argument names after the UPnP action has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: Array of output argument names or {@code null} if there are no output arguments.

section.title: public abstract String getReturnArgumentName()
section.para: Returns the name of the designated return argument.
One of the output arguments can be flagged as a designated return argument.
This method must continue to return the action return argument name after the UPnP action has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The name of the designated return argument or {@code null} if none is marked.

section.title: public abstract UPnPStateVariable getStateVariable(String argumentName)

formalpara.title: argumentName
formalpara.para: The name of the UPnP action argument.

section.para:
Finds the state variable associated with an argument name.
Helps to resolve the association of state variables with argument names in UPnP actions.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: State variable associated with the named argument or {@code null} if there is no such argument.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– if the UPnP action has been removed from the network.

section.title: public abstract Dictionary<String, Object> invoke(Dictionary<String, Object> args) throws Exception

formalpara.title: args
formalpara.para: A {@code Dictionary} of arguments. Must contain the correct set and type of arguments for this action. May be {@code null} if no input arguments exist.

section.para:
Invokes the action.
The input and output arguments are both passed as {@code Dictionary} objects. Each entry in the {@code Dictionary} object has a {@code String} object as key representing the argument name and the value is the argument itself. The class of an argument value must be assignable from the class of the associated UPnP state variable.
The input argument {@code Dictionary} object must contain exactly those arguments listed by {@code getInputArguments} method. The output argument {@code Dictionary} object will contain exactly those arguments listed by {@code getOutputArguments} method.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A {@code Dictionary} with the output arguments. {@code null} if the action has no output arguments.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: UPnPException– A UPnP error has occurred.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– if the UPnP action has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: Exception– The execution fails for some reason.

section.title: public abstract UPnPDevice
section.para:
Represents a UPnP device.
For each UPnP root and embedded device, an object is registered with the framework under the {@code UPnPDevice} interface.
The relationship between a root device and its embedded devices can be deduced using the {@code UPnPDevice.CHILDREN_UDN} and {@code UPnPDevice.PARENT_UDN} service registration properties.
The values of the UPnP property names are defined by the UPnP Forum.
All values of the UPnP properties are obtained from the device using the device's default locale.
If an application wants to query for a set of localized property values, it has to use the method {@code UPnPDevice.getDescriptions(String locale)}.

section.title: public static final String CHILDREN_UDN = "UPnP.device.childrenUDN"
section.para: The property key that must be set for all devices containing other embedded devices.
The value is an array of UDNs for each of the device's children ( {@code String[]}). The array contains UDNs for the immediate descendants only.
If an embedded device in turn contains embedded devices, the latter are not included in the array.
The UPnP Specification does not encourage more than two levels of nesting.
The property is not set if the device does not contain embedded devices.
The property is of type {@code String[]}. Value is "UPnP.device.childrenUDN"

section.title: public static final String DEVICE_CATEGORY = "UPnP"
section.para: Constant for the value of the service property {@code DEVICE_CATEGORY} used for all UPnP devices. Value is "UPnP".

section.title: public static final String FRIENDLY_NAME = "UPnP.device.friendlyName"
section.para: Mandatory property key for a short user friendly version of the device name. The property value holds a {@code String} object with the user friendly name of the device. Value is "UPnP.device.friendlyName".

section.title: public static final String ID = "UPnP.device.UDN"
section.para: Property key for the Unique Device ID property. This property is an alias to {@code UPnPDevice.UDN}. It is merely provided for reasons of symmetry with the {@code UPnPService.ID} property. The value of the property is a {@code String} object of the Device UDN. The value of the key is "UPnP.device.UDN".

section.title: public static final String MANUFACTURER = "UPnP.device.manufacturer"
section.para: Mandatory property key for the device manufacturer's property. The property value holds a String representation of the device manufacturer's name. Value is "UPnP.device.manufacturer".

section.title: public static final String MANUFACTURER_URL = "UPnP.device.manufacturerURL"
section.para: Optional property key for a URL to the device manufacturers Web site. The value of the property is a {@code String} object representing the URL. Value is "UPnP.device.manufacturerURL".

section.title: public static final int MATCH_GENERIC = 1
section.para: Constant for the UPnP device match scale, indicating a generic match for the device. Value is 1.

section.title: public static final int MATCH_MANUFACTURER_MODEL = 7
section.para: Constant for the UPnP device match scale, indicating a match with the device model. Value is 7.

section.title: public static final int MATCH_MANUFACTURER_MODEL_REVISION = 15
section.para: Constant for the UPnP device match scale, indicating a match with the device revision. Value is 15.

section.title: public static final int MATCH_MANUFACTURER_MODEL_REVISION_SERIAL = 31
section.para: Constant for the UPnP device match scale, indicating a match with the device revision and the serial number. Value is 31.

section.title: public static final int MATCH_TYPE = 3
section.para: Constant for the UPnP device match scale, indicating a match with the device type. Value is 3.

section.title: public static final String MODEL_DESCRIPTION = "UPnP.device.modelDescription"
section.para: Optional (but recommended) property key for a {@code String} object with a long description of the device for the end user. The value is "UPnP.device.modelDescription".

section.title: public static final String MODEL_NAME = "UPnP.device.modelName"
section.para: Mandatory property key for the device model name. The property value holds a {@code String} object giving more information about the device model. Value is "UPnP.device.modelName".

section.title: public static final String MODEL_NUMBER = "UPnP.device.modelNumber"
section.para: Optional (but recommended) property key for a {@code String} class typed property holding the model number of the device. Value is "UPnP.device.modelNumber".

section.title: public static final String MODEL_URL = "UPnP.device.modelURL"
section.para: Optional property key for a {@code String} typed property holding a string representing the URL to the Web site for this model. Value is "UPnP.device.modelURL".

section.title: public static final String PARENT_UDN = "UPnP.device.parentUDN"
section.para: The property key that must be set for all embedded devices. It contains the UDN of the parent device. The property is not set for root devices. The value is "UPnP.device.parentUDN".

section.title: public static final String PRESENTATION_URL = "UPnP.presentationURL"
section.para: Optional (but recommended) property key for a {@code String} typed property holding a string representing the URL to a device representation Web page. Value is "UPnP.presentationURL".

section.title: public static final String SERIAL_NUMBER = "UPnP.device.serialNumber"
section.para: Optional (but recommended) property key for a {@code String} typed property holding the serial number of the device. Value is "UPnP.device.serialNumber".

section.title: public static final String TYPE = "UPnP.device.type"
section.para: Property key for the UPnP Device Type property. Some standard property values are defined by the Universal Plug and Play Forum. The type string also includes a version number as defined in the UPnP specification. This property must be set.
For standard devices defined by a UPnP Forum working committee, this must consist of the following components in the given order separated by colons:
For non-standard devices specified by UPnP vendors following components must be specified in the given order separated by colons:

listitem.para: an ICANN domain name owned by the vendor

section.para: To allow for backward compatibility the UPnP driver must automatically generate additional Device Type property entries for smaller versions than the current one. If for example a device announces its type as version 3, then properties for versions 2 and 1 must be automatically generated.
In the case of exporting a UPnPDevice, the highest available version must be announced on the network.
Syntax Example: {@code urn:schemas-upnp-org:device:deviceType:v}
The value is "UPnP.device.type".

section.title: public static final String UDN = "UPnP.device.UDN"
section.para: Property key for the Unique Device Name (UDN) property. It is the unique identifier of an instance of a {@code UPnPDevice}. The value of the property is a {@code String} object of the Device UDN. Value of the key is "UPnP.device.UDN". This property must be set.

section.title: public static final String UPC = "UPnP.device.UPC"
section.para: Optional property key for a {@code String} typed property holding the Universal Product Code (UPC) of the device. Value is "UPnP.device.UPC".

section.title: public static final String UPNP_EXPORT = "UPnP.export"
section.para: The {@code UPnP.export} service property is a hint that marks a device to be picked up and exported by the UPnP Service. Imported devices do not have this property set. The registered property requires no value.
The UPNP_EXPORT string is "UPnP.export".

section.title: public abstract Dictionary<String, Object> getDescriptions(String locale)

formalpara.title: locale
formalpara.para: A language tag as defined by RFC 1766 and maintained by ISO 639. Examples include "{@code de}", "{@code en}" or " {@code en-US}". The default locale of the device is specified by passing a {@code null} argument.

section.para:
Get a set of localized UPnP properties.
The UPnP specification allows a device to present different device properties based on the client's locale. The properties used to register the UPnPDevice service in the OSGi registry are based on the device's default locale. To obtain a localized set of the properties, an application can use this method.
Not all properties might be available in all locales. This method does not substitute missing properties with their default locale versions.
This method must continue to return the properties after the UPnP device has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: Dictionary mapping property name Strings to property value Strings

section.title: public abstract UPnPIcon[][] getIcons(String locale)

formalpara.title: locale
formalpara.para: A language tag as defined by RFC 1766 and maintained by ISO 639. Examples include "{@code de}", "{@code en}" or " {@code en-US}". The default locale of the device is specified by passing a {@code null} argument.

section.para:
Lists all icons for this device in a given locale.
The UPnP specification allows a device to present different icons based on the client's locale.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: Array of icons or null if no icons are available.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– if the UPnP device has been removed from the network.

section.title: public abstract UPnPService getService(String serviceId)

formalpara.title: serviceId
formalpara.para: The service id

section.para: Locates a specific service by its service id.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The requested service or null if not found.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– if the UPnP device has been removed from the network.

section.title: public abstract UPnPService[][] getServices()
section.para: Lists all services provided by this device.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: Array of services or {@code null} if no services are available.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– if the UPnP device has been removed from the network.

section.title: public abstract UPnPEventListener
section.para: UPnP Events are mapped and delivered to applications according to the OSGi whiteboard model. An application that wishes to be notified of events generated by a particular UPnP Device registers a service extending this interface.

Upon registration of the UPnP Event Listener service with the Framework, the service is notified for each variable which it listens for with an initial event containing the current value of the variable. Subsequent notifications only happen on changes of the value of the variable.
A UPnP Event Listener service filter the events it receives. This event set is limited using a standard framework filter expression which is specified when the listener service is registered.
The filter is specified in a property named "upnp.filter" and has as a value an object of type {@code org.osgi.framework.Filter}.
When the Filter is evaluated, the following keywords are recognized as defined as literal constants in the {@code UPnPDevice} class.
The valid subset of properties for the registration of UPnP Event Listener services are:

listitem.para: {@code UPnPDevice.TYPE}-- Which type of device to listen for events.
{@code UPnPDevice.ID}-- The ID of a specific device to listen for events.
{@code UPnPService.TYPE}-- The type of a specific service to listen for events.
{@code UPnPService.ID}-- The ID of a specific service to listen for events.

section.title: public static final String UPNP_FILTER = "upnp.filter"
section.para: Key for a service property having a value that is an object of type {@code org.osgi.framework.Filter} and that is used to limit received events.

section.title: public abstract void notifyUPnPEvent(String deviceId, String serviceId, Dictionary<String, Object> events)

formalpara.title: deviceId
formalpara.para: ID of the device sending the events

formalpara.title: serviceId
formalpara.para: ID of the service sending the events

formalpara.title: events
formalpara.para: {@code Dictionary} object containing the new values for the state variables that have changed.

section.para:
Callback method that is invoked for received events.
The events are collected in a {@code Dictionary} object. Each entry has a {@code String} key representing the event name (= state variable name) and the new value of the state variable. The class of the value object must match the class specified by the UPnP State Variable associated with the event. This method must be called asynchronously

section.title: public class UPnPException extends Exception
section.para: There are several defined error situations describing UPnP problems while a control point invokes actions to UPnPDevices.

formalpara.title: Since
formalpara.para: @since 1.1

section.title: public static final int DEVICE_INTERNAL_ERROR = 501
section.para: The invoked action failed during execution.

section.title: public static final int INVALID_ACTION = 401
section.para: No Action found by that name at this service.

section.title: public static final int INVALID_ARGS = 402
section.para: Not enough arguments, too many arguments with a specific name, or one of more of the arguments are of the wrong type.

section.title: public static final int INVALID_SEQUENCE_NUMBER = 403
section.para: The different end-points are no longer in synchronization.

section.title: public static final int INVALID_VARIABLE = 404
section.para: Refers to a non existing variable.

section.title: public UPnPException(int errorCode, String errorDescription)

formalpara.title: errorCode

formalpara.title: errorDescription

section.para: This constructor creates a {@code UPnPException} on the specified error code and error description.

section.title: public UPnPException(int errorCode, String errorDescription, Throwable errorCause)

formalpara.title: errorDescription

formalpara.title: errorCause

section.title: public int getUPnPError_Code()
section.para: Returns the UPnPError Code occurred by UPnPDevices during invocation.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The UPnPErrorCode defined by a UPnP Forum working committee or specified by a UPnP vendor.

section.title: public int getUPnPErrorCode()
section.para: Returns the UPnP Error Code occurred by UPnPDevices during invocation.

formalpara.para: The UPnPErrorCode defined by a UPnP Forum working committee or specified by a UPnP vendor.

section.title: public abstract UPnPIcon
section.para:
A UPnP icon representation.
Each UPnP device can contain zero or more icons.

section.title: public abstract int getDepth()
section.para: Returns the color depth of the icon in bits.
This method must continue to return the icon depth after the UPnP device has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The color depth in bits. If the actual color depth of the icon is unknown, -1 is returned.

section.title: public abstract int getHeight()
section.para:
Returns the height of the icon in pixels.
If the actual height of the icon is unknown, -1 is returned.
This method must continue to return the icon height after the UPnP device has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The height in pixels, or -1 if unknown.

section.title: public abstract InputStream getInputStream() throws IOException
section.para:
Returns an {@code InputStream} object for the icon data.
The {@code InputStream} object provides a way for a client to read the actual icon graphics data. The number of bytes available from this {@code InputStream} object can be determined via the {@code getSize()} method. The format of the data encoded can be determined by the MIME type available via the {@code getMimeType()} method.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: An InputStream to read the icon graphics data from.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If the {@code InputStream} cannot be returned.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– if the UPnP device has been removed from the network.

section.title: public abstract String getMimeType()
section.para:
Returns the MIME type of the icon.
This method returns the format in which the icon graphics, read from the {@code InputStream} object obtained by the {@code getInputStream()} method, is encoded.
The format of the returned string is in accordance to RFC2046. A list of valid MIME types is maintained by the IANA.
Typical values returned include: "image/jpeg" or "image/gif"
This method must continue to return the icon MIME type after the UPnP device has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The MIME type of the encoded icon.

section.title: public abstract int getSize()
section.para:
Returns the size of the icon in bytes.
This method returns the number of bytes of the icon available to read from the {@code InputStream} object obtained by the {@code getInputStream()} method. If the actual size can not be determined, -1 is returned.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The icon size in bytes, or -1 if the size is unknown.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– if the UPnP device has been removed from the network.

section.title: public abstract int getWidth()
section.para:
Returns the width of the icon in pixels.
If the actual width of the icon is unknown, -1 is returned.
This method must continue to return the icon width after the UPnP device has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The width in pixels, or -1 if unknown.

section.title: public abstract UPnPLocalStateVariable extends UPnPStateVariable
section.para: A local UPnP state variable which allows the value of the state variable to be queried.

formalpara.title: Since
formalpara.para: @since 1.1

section.title: public abstract Object getCurrentValue()
section.para: This method will keep the current values of UPnPStateVariables of a UPnPDevice whenever UPnPStateVariable's value is changed , this method must be called.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: {@code Object} current value of UPnPStateVariable. If the current value is initialized with the default value defined UPnP service description.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– If the UPnP state variable has been removed.

section.title: public abstract UPnPService
section.para:
A representation of a UPnP Service.
Each UPnP device contains zero or more services. The UPnP description for a service defines actions, their arguments, and event characteristics.

section.title: public static final String ID = "UPnP.service.id"
section.para:
Property key for the optional service id.
The service id property is used when registering UPnP Device services or UPnP Event Listener services. The value of the property contains a {@code String} array ({@code String[]}) of service ids. A UPnP Device service can thus announce what service ids it contains. A UPnP Event Listener service can announce for what UPnP service ids it wants notifications. A service id does not have to be universally unique. It must be unique only within a device. A {@code null} value is a wildcard, matching all services. The value is "UPnP.service.id".

section.title: public static final String TYPE = "UPnP.service.type"
section.para:
Property key for the optional service type uri.
The service type property is used when registering UPnP Device services and UPnP Event Listener services. The property contains a {@code String} array ({@code String[]}) of service types. A UPnP Device service can thus announce what types of services it contains. A UPnP Event Listener service can announce for what type of UPnP services it wants notifications. The service version is encoded in the type string as specified in the UPnP specification. A {@code null} value is a wildcard, matching all service types. Value is "UPnP.service.type".

section.title: public abstract UPnPAction getAction(String name)

formalpara.title: name
formalpara.para: Name of action. Must not contain hyphen or hash characters. Should be < 32 characters.

section.para:
Locates a specific action by name.
Looks up an action by its name.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The requested action or {@code null} if no action is found.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– if the UPnP service has been removed from the network.

section.title: public abstract UPnPAction[][] getActions()
section.para: Lists all actions provided by this service.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: Array of actions ({@code UPnPAction[]} )or {@code null} if no actions are defined for this service.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– if the UPnP service has been removed from the network.

section.title: public abstract String getId()
section.para: Returns the {@code serviceId} field in the UPnP service description.
For standard services defined by a UPnP Forum working committee, the serviceId must contain the following components in the indicated order:
Example: {@code urn:upnp-org:serviceId:serviceID}.
Note that {@code upnp-org} is used instead of {@code schemas-upnp-org} in this example because an XML schema is not defined for each serviceId.
For non-standard services specified by UPnP vendors, the serviceId must contain the following components in the indicated order:

listitem.para: ICANN domain name owned by the vendor

section.para: Example: {@code urn:domain-name:serviceId:serviceID}.
This method must continue to return the service id after the UPnP service has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The service ID suffix defined by a UPnP Forum working committee or specified by a UPnP vendor. Must be <= 64 characters. Single URI.

section.title: public abstract UPnPStateVariable getStateVariable(String name)

formalpara.title: name
formalpara.para: Name of the State Variable

section.para: Gets a {@code UPnPStateVariable} objects provided by this service by name

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: State variable or {@code null} if no such state variable exists for this service.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– if the UPnP service has been removed from the network.

section.title: public abstract UPnPStateVariable[][] getStateVariables()
section.para: Lists all {@code UPnPStateVariable} objects provided by this service.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: Array of state variables or {@code null} if none are defined for this service.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– if the UPnP service has been removed from the network.

section.title: public abstract String getType()
section.para: Returns the {@code serviceType} field in the UPnP service description.
For standard services defined by a UPnP Forum working committee, the serviceType must contain the following components in the indicated order:
Example: {@code urn:schemas-upnp-org:service:serviceType:v}.
For non-standard services specified by UPnP vendors, the {@code serviceType} must contain the following components in the indicated order:

listitem.para: ICANN domain name owned by the vendor

section.para: Example: {@code urn:domain-name:service:serviceType:v}.
This method must continue to return the service type after the UPnP service has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The service type suffix defined by a UPnP Forum working committee or specified by a UPnP vendor. Must be <= 64 characters, not including the version suffix and separating colon. Single URI.

section.title: public abstract String getVersion()
section.para: Returns the version suffix encoded in the {@code serviceType} field in the UPnP service description.
This method must continue to return the service version after the UPnP service has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The integer service version defined by a UPnP Forum working committee or specified by a UPnP vendor.

section.title: public abstract UPnPStateVariable
section.para: The meta-information of a UPnP state variable as declared in the device's service state table (SST).
Method calls to interact with a device (e.g. {@code UPnPAction.invoke(...);}) use this class to encapsulate meta information about the input and output arguments.
The actual values of the arguments are passed as Java objects. The mapping of types from UPnP data types to Java data types is described with the field definitions.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_BIN_BASE64 = "bin.base64"
section.para: MIME-style Base64 encoded binary BLOB.
Takes 3 Bytes, splits them into 4 parts, and maps each 6 bit piece to an octet. (3 octets are encoded as 4.) No limit on size.
Mapped to {@code byte[]} object. The Java byte array will hold the decoded content of the BLOB.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_BIN_HEX = "bin.hex"
section.para: Hexadecimal digits representing octets.
Treats each nibble as a hex digit and encodes as a separate Byte. (1 octet is encoded as 2.) No limit on size.
Mapped to {@code byte[]} object. The Java byte array will hold the decoded content of the BLOB.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_BOOLEAN = "boolean"
section.para: True or false.
Mapped to {@code Boolean} object.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_CHAR = "char"
section.para: Unicode string.
One character long.
Mapped to {@code Character} object.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_DATE = "date"
section.para: A calendar date.
Date in a subset of ISO 8601 format without time data.
See http://www.w3.org/TR/ xmlschema-2/#date .
Mapped to {@code java.util.Date} object. Always 00:00 hours.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_DATETIME = "dateTime"
section.para: A specific instant of time.
Date in ISO 8601 format with optional time but no time zone.
See http://www.w3.org /TR/xmlschema-2/#dateTime .
Mapped to {@code java.util.Date} object using default time zone.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_DATETIME_TZ = "dateTime.tz"
section.para: A specific instant of time.
Date in ISO 8601 format with optional time and optional time zone.
See http://www.w3.org /TR/xmlschema-2/#dateTime .
Mapped to {@code java.util.Date} object adjusted to default time zone.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_FIXED_14_4 = "fixed.14.4"
section.para: Same as r8 but no more than 14 digits to the left of the decimal point and no more than 4 to the right.
Mapped to {@code Double} object.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_FLOAT = "float"
section.para: Floating-point number.

Mantissa (left of the decimal) and/or exponent may have a leading sign. Mantissa and/or exponent may have leading zeros. Decimal character in mantissa is a period, i.e., whole digits in mantissa separated from fractional digits by period. Mantissa separated from exponent by E. (No currency symbol.) (No grouping of digits in the mantissa, e.g., no commas.)
Mapped to {@code Float} object.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_I1 = "i1"
section.para: 1 Byte int.
Mapped to {@code Integer} object.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_I2 = "i2"
section.para: 2 Byte int.
Mapped to {@code Integer} object.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_I4 = "i4"
section.para: 4 Byte int.
Must be between -2147483648 and 2147483647
Mapped to {@code Integer} object.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_INT = "int"
section.para: Integer number.
Mapped to {@code Integer} object.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_NUMBER = "number"
section.para: Same as r8.
Mapped to {@code Double} object.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_R4 = "r4"
section.para: 4 Byte float.
Same format as float. Must be between 3.40282347E+38 to 1.17549435E-38.
Mapped to {@code Float} object.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_R8 = "r8"
section.para: 8 Byte float.

Same format as float. Must be between -1.79769313486232E308 and -4.94065645841247E-324 for negative values, and between 4.94065645841247E-324 and 1.79769313486232E308 for positive values, i.e., IEEE 64-bit (8-Byte) double.
Mapped to {@code Double} object.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_STRING = "string"
section.para: Unicode string.
No limit on length.
Mapped to {@code String} object.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_TIME = "time"
section.para: An instant of time that recurs every day.
Time in a subset of ISO 8601 format with no date and no time zone.
See http://www.w3.org /TR/xmlschema-2/#time .
Mapped to {@code Long}. Converted to milliseconds since midnight.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_TIME_TZ = "time.tz"
section.para: An instant of time that recurs every day.
Time in a subset of ISO 8601 format with optional time zone but no date.
See http://www.w3.org /TR/xmlschema-2/#time .
Mapped to {@code Long} object. Converted to milliseconds since midnight and adjusted to default time zone, wrapping at 0 and 24*60*60*1000.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_UI1 = "ui1"
section.para: Unsigned 1 {@code Byte} int.
Mapped to an {@code Integer} object.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_UI2 = "ui2"
section.para: Unsigned 2 Byte int.
Mapped to {@code Integer} object.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_UI4 = "ui4"
section.para: Unsigned 4 Byte int.
Mapped to {@code Long} object.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_URI = "uri"
section.para: Universal Resource Identifier.
Mapped to {@code String} object.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_UUID = "uuid"
section.para: Universally Unique ID.
Hexadecimal digits representing octets. Optional embedded hyphens are ignored.
Mapped to {@code String} object.

section.title: public abstract String[][] getAllowedValues()
section.para: Returns the allowed values, if defined. Allowed values can be defined only for String types.
This method must continue to return the state variable allowed values after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The allowed values or {@code null} if not defined. Should be less than 32 characters.

section.title: public abstract Object getDefaultValue()
section.para: Returns the default value, if defined.
This method must continue to return the state variable default value after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The default value or {@code null} if not defined. The type of the returned object can be determined by {@code getJavaDataType}.

section.title: public abstract Class<?> getJavaDataType()
section.para: Returns the Java class associated with the UPnP data type of this state variable.
Mapping between the UPnP data types and Java classes is performed according to the schema mentioned above.
section.programlisting: Integer ui1, ui2, i1, i2, i4, int Long ui4, time, time.tz Float r4, float Double r8, number, fixed.14.4 Character char String string, uri, uuid Date date, dateTime, dateTime.tz Boolean boolean byte[] bin.base64, bin.hex
section.para: This method must continue to return the state variable java type after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A class object corresponding to the Java type of this argument.

section.title: public abstract Number getMaximum()
section.para: Returns the maximum value, if defined. Maximum values can only be defined for numeric types.
This method must continue to return the state variable maximum value after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The maximum value or {@code null} if not defined.

section.title: public abstract Number getMinimum()
section.para: Returns the minimum value, if defined. Minimum values can only be defined for numeric types.
This method must continue to return the state variable minimum value after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The minimum value or {@code null} if not defined.

section.title: public abstract String getName()
section.para: Returns the variable name.

listitem.para: All standard variables defined by a UPnP Forum working committee must not begin with {@code X_} nor {@code A_}.
All non-standard variables specified by a UPnP vendor and added to a standard service must begin with {@code X_}.

section.para: This method must continue to return the state variable name after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: Name of state variable. Must not contain a hyphen character nor a hash character. Should be < 32 characters.

section.title: public abstract Number getStep()
section.para: Returns the size of an increment operation, if defined. Step sizes can be defined only for numeric types.
This method must continue to return the step size after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The increment size or null if not defined.

section.title: public abstract String getUPnPDataType()
section.para: Returns the UPnP type of this state variable. Valid types are defined as constants.
This method must continue to return the state variable UPnP data type after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The UPnP data type of this state variable, as defined in above constants.

section.title: public abstract boolean sendsEvents()
section.para:
Tells if this StateVariable can be used as an event source.
If the StateVariable is eventable, an event listener service can be registered to be notified when changes to the variable appear.
This method must continue to return the correct value after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: {@code true} if the {@code StateVariable} generates events, {@code false} otherwise.
